name: Classic Chili

ingredients.item: tomato-free chili paste or chipotle in adobo

instructions: Brown ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat. Drain fat.
Add onion and garlic. Cook 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, paprika, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook 1 minute.
Add beef broth and chili paste. Stir well.
Bring to a boil then reduce heat. Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and season with salt and pepper. Serve with sour cream and shredded cheese.

substitutions.dairy_free: Skip sour cream and cheese toppings or use dairy-free versions.
substitutions.low_carb: Skip the beans and add diced bell peppers instead.
substitutions.vegetarian: Replace ground beef with an extra can of beans and 1 cup diced mushrooms.

notes: Tomato-free chili — beef broth and Worcestershire give it great depth.
